skills.summary: Discovers and loads SKILL.md files shipped by this repo.
skills.degradation: None possible — a target without skills is not a supported target.

skill_auto_invocation.summary: Selects a skill from its description without the user naming it.
skill_auto_invocation.degradation: Document the explicit invocation form (slash command or 'use the X skill') in the install guide.

subagents.summary: Delegates a bounded task to a separate agent with its own context.
subagents.degradation: Run the role inline in the main session, sequentially, with a narrowed scope.

parallel_subagents.summary: Runs two or more subagents concurrently.
parallel_subagents.degradation: Fan out sequentially; the task graph still holds, only wall-clock time changes.

agent_teams.summary: Long-lived named agents that message each other during a session.
agent_teams.degradation: Use one-shot subagents plus files under session-files/ as the message bus.

hooks.summary: Runs THIS REPO'S declared hook scripts on that platform's lifecycle events. Like every row here, this describes this repo's artifacts on that platform, not the platform's abstract feature set: the question is 'if I install this plugin there, do my hooks run?', not 'is that product hooks-capable?'
hooks.degradation: Move the guard into the skill body as an explicit step, and into CI as a check.

mcp.summary: Connects Model Context Protocol servers declared by the repo.
mcp.degradation: Use the equivalent CLI (gh, curl) through the shell capability.

statusline.summary: Renders a repo-provided status line in the session chrome.
statusline.degradation: Purely cosmetic — omit it. Never make a skill depend on it.

shell.summary: Executes arbitrary shell commands in the workspace.
shell.degradation: Emit the commands for the user to run and wait for pasted output.

git.summary: Git is on PATH and the workspace is a repository.
git.degradation: Skip branch/commit/worktree workflows; skills that need them declare git as required.

github_cli.summary: The gh CLI is installed and authenticated.
github_cli.degradation: Optional feature dependency. Fall back to printing the PR/issue body for the user to file manually.

background_tasks.summary: Runs a long command detached and reports its exit later.
background_tasks.degradation: Run in the foreground with a bounded timeout.

worktree_isolation.summary: Each task gets its own git worktree so concurrent agents do not collide.
worktree_isolation.degradation: Single checkout, one task at a time; the orchestrator serializes writes.

plugin_marketplace.summary: Installs and updates this plugin from a hosted marketplace listing.
plugin_marketplace.degradation: Document a direct install path (git clone plus a local plugin/extension link).

extension_install.summary: Installs the repo directly as an extension from a git URL.
extension_install.degradation: Use the platform's own install path; this is not a universal mechanism.

slash_commands.degradation: Users invoke the skill by describing it in prose.

ask_user_question.summary: Presents a structured multiple-choice question mid-run.
ask_user_question.degradation: Ask in prose and stop for a free-text reply.

artifacts.summary: Publishes a rendered HTML/Markdown page as a shareable artifact.
artifacts.degradation: Write the same content to a file in the repo and tell the user the path.

session_transcripts.summary: Session history is readable on disk in a documented format.
session_transcripts.degradation: Usage analytics (session-report) are unavailable; say so rather than reporting zeros.
